_comment: Glance — Cosmos DB NoSQL schema reference. Apply via ARM, Bicep, or Azure Portal.

database.name: GlanceDB
database.note: Use Serverless capacity for free-tier eligibility and low-traffic household workloads. Switch to 400 RU/s shared provisioned if you exceed 5GB or need SLA guarantees.

containers.name: Chores
notes: Partition key /assignedUser keeps per-person queries single-partition (fast + cheap).
completedDates is an array of ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD). MidnightResetTimer trims it to last 7 days to control document growth.
Recurrence values: 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'once'. daysOfWeek is only evaluated for 'weekly'.
Valid assignedUser values must match the USERS array in state.js: 'anna', 'simeon', 'tennille', 'bibi'.

containers.name: Lists
notes: Partition key /listType isolates list queries: all 'grocery' items are co-located.
defaultTtl of 2592000 = 30 days. Checked/deleted items auto-expire without manual cleanup.
Text is excluded from the index to avoid RU cost on large item names — filter by checked/addedBy/createdAt instead.
For real-time sync across devices, Azure Web PubSub should publish a 'lists:changed' event after each POST/PUT/DELETE via the /api/lists endpoint.

conflictResolution.note: For a single-region family app, LWW on _ts timestamp is sufficient. If multi-region replication is added, implement a custom merge procedure on the completedDates array in the Chores container.
